open(f,'w').write('def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w-2):
            if grid[i][j] == grid[i][j+2] and grid[i][j] != bg and grid[i][j] != grid[i][j+1]:
                out[i][j+1] = 2
    return out
')
